name: Decision Room AI
tagline: Turn difficult choices into clear, defensible decisions.
description: Decision Room AI replaces vague pros-and-cons lists with a rigorous, saved decision workspace. Frame the real question, compare options against weighted criteria, expose assumptions, run an AI premortem and scenario analysis, then record a commitment and revisit the outcome. Every score remains editable and explainable, decisions sync through Anna Storage, and AI guidance uses the user's Anna model access—no separate API key required.
